item.name: Compass
item.effect: Points toward the nearest objective, or north when no objectives are available.
item.cardSummary: Cheap early utility that steers you toward map objectives when you are lost.
item.notes: Can briefly aim at a closer saferoom door instead of its lever until you move away.

item.name: Timer
item.effect: Shows remaining time in the current round on a HUD timer.
item.cardSummary: Low-cost info tool for pacing rounds and planning when to hide or push objectives.
item.notes: Does not improve survivability by itself.

item.name: Radio
item.effect: Marks a nextbot location on use when the target is in sight, and applies a 5% slow while the Radio is selected.
item.cardSummary: Budget awareness tool for tagging hard-to-see nextbots and taking a small slow passive.
item.notes: Marks are personal and are not shared with other players who also equip a Radio.

item.name: Radar
item.effect: Plays a ping that speeds up as a nextbot gets closer, with a matching HUD pulse.
item.cardSummary: Proximity warning utility that helps on dark or maze maps where nextbots are hard to see.
item.notes: Does not show exact direction, only how close the threat is.

item.name: Decoy Panel
item.effect: Spawns a transparent clone that walks forward and can draw nextbot attention.
item.cardSummary: Active distraction tool for buying escape or revive windows when a nextbot is locked on you.
item.notes: Place in open space so barriers do not stop the decoy. Some nextbots may still ignore it. Duration uses Fandom post-Overhaul values (older guides still list about 30 seconds).

item.name: Stun Baton
item.effect: Melee power tool that can temporarily stun nextbots on hit, and can kill some weaker 3D nextbots.
item.cardSummary: Mid-level Power option for stopping chase pressure when you can land a clean hit.
item.notes: Misses leave you exposed. Exact stun timings are not fully sourced.

item.name: Grapple
item.effect: Hooks onto surfaces and launches you toward the attach point for high mobility escapes.
item.cardSummary: Core Power mobility tool for vertical routes and hard disengages once you reach level 50.
item.notes: Failed out-of-range hooks do not spend a use. Boost Pack and emotes are disabled while Grapple is equipped.

item.name: Breacher
item.effect: Places a blue and yellow portal pair for instant travel while conserving momentum.
item.cardSummary: Endgame Power for pre-placed portal routes and long-range escapes on large maps.
item.notes: Most expensive public equipment. Price uses Fandom $1050 after the Christmas 2025 increase (older guides still list $950). Unequipping clears active portals.
